# Orvio 0.37

- New start-up animation, drawn by Orvio itself instead of a video: sharp on every screen, smooth at your screen's frame rate and shorter (3 seconds). The logo blooms with a golden glow and circling sparks, then fades straight into the app.
- It also plays when Android's animations are switched off, and it starts only once the screen is ready, so you always see it from the beginning.
